We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.
We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource.
What we do:
For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​
The Watts Internship Program is your chance to bring what you’ve learned in the classroom to life! You’ll dive into real-world projects, gaining hands-on experience while learning how business really works from the inside. During the program, you’ll get to roll up your sleeves and make an impact on day-to-day operations. Plus, you'll have tons of opportunities to network with passionate professionals across manufacturing, industrial engineering, and more—sparking new ideas through cross-department collaboration. It’s all about expanding your skills, challenging yourself, and exploring where your ambitions can take you!
Scope of Position
As a valued member of the Manufacturing Engineering team, the Manufacturing Quality Intern will contribute to impactful projects that support factory transformation, product line optimization, and production floor redesign. This internship offers hands-on experience in a dynamic manufacturing environment, providing exposure to real-world engineering challenges and opportunities to collaborate across teams.
This position reports to the Quality and Sustaining Engineer Supervisor and is onsite in Fort Myers, FL.
Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities
Collaborate with the Manufacturing Engineering team on the factory transformation initiative, focusing on modernizing workflows, integrating new technologies, and driving process improvements.
Support efforts to optimize the MCX/MCX2 product line, a key component of our business, through data analysis, process mapping, and continuous improvement strategies.
Assist in the redesign of the production floor layout to enhance operational efficiency, reduce waste, and improve safety and ergonomics.
Provide ongoing support for cross-functional engineering projects, including documentation, testing, and implementation activities.
Participate in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and project reviews, gaining exposure to engineering decision-making and project management.
Deliver a final presentation summarizing internship learnings, contributions, and outcomes to the leadership team.
Required Qualifications
Current student (junior or senior status).
Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to learning.
Effective communication and collaboration skills.
Passionate about your work, with a genuine desire to contribute meaningfully and make an impact.
Demonstrated commitment to integrity and respect in interactions with others, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
Strong sense of accountability, taking ownership of tasks and following through on commitments.
Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable.
Must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.
Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment.
Preferred Qualifications
Preferably pursuing a degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Process, or Manufacturing Engineering.
Exposure to Lean Manufacturing principles and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma tools and techniques.
General Applicable Company Competencies
Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.
Punctuality and dependability.
Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.
Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.
Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.
Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action.
Working Conditions:
While performing the job duties, you will be working on-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Fort Myers, FL location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager.
Physical Requirements: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:
Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods.
Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.
Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials.
Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks.
Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls.
Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry light objects, such as office supplies, documents, or small equipment.
Ability to stand for long periods of time.
Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds.
Ability to push and pull up to 30 pounds.
Ability to physically move around manufacturing floor.
Ability to read documents and communicate clearly with management and coworkers.
Ability to wear personal protective equipment, which may include, but is not limited to, safety shoes, hearing protection, and safety glasses.
Pay Range:
The expected hourly range for this position is $22- $26 hourly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law.
What's In It for You
People-First Culture – Enriching and caring for people is at the core of who we are; this includes executing our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategy, and providing you with meaningful career growth opportunities, a positive and safe work environment, and affirmation that you are heard, valued, and respected.
Flexible PTO Policy – Work-life balance is important at Watts and our interns receive one (1) hour of flexible PTO for every thirty (30) hours worked. Your flexible PTO can be utilized for any type of absence.
Paid Holidays – Celebrate the holidays with your loved ones and still get paid! You will receive the following paid holidays off during your time as an Intern with Watts. Where a holiday falls during the weekend, it will be observed on an adjacent weekday.
Lunch and Learns – Throughout your internship, there will be opportunities for you to sign up to learn and network with some of the key strategic leaders and thought partners within our core operating model!
Sustainability – For five years in a row, Watts has been named one of "America's Most Responsible Companies" by Newsweek. Join our journey as we continue to distinguish Watts as a responsible and committed corporate citizen.
Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason.

Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience
Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits

10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off

Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs

About Us
Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.
About the Role
Wellington Management is seeking motivated undergraduate students to join our 2027 Business Undergraduate Summer Internship Program. This 10-week paid internship provides hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to the investment management industry.
Interns will work full-time (40 hours/week) at our Boston headquarters starting June 2027. Interns are also eligible for a housing stipend and a flexible work model that includes four days per week in the office and one remote workday.
This program is designed to help students build professional skills, explore career paths, and contribute to meaningful projects alongside experienced professionals.
What You’ll Do:
As a summer intern, you will join a team within Wellington’s Client, Investment or Infrastructure platforms and gain exposure to the business functions that support a leading global investment management firm.
You may:
Support day-to-day team projects and strategic initiatives
Conduct research, data analysis, and process improvements
Collaborate with teams across the firm
Work on a summer project solving a real business challenge
At the end of the summer, you will have the opportunity to present your work and insights to senior leaders, mentors, and your peers.
Internship Opportunities
Interns may be placed in one of several business areas that align to intern’s interests, skills and business need. You will have the opportunity to indicate your preferences during the application process.
Client Platform – The Client Platform is a global team focused on building and deepening relationships with prospects, clients, and consultants. Working closely with Wellington's investment professionals, the team helps clients navigate complex investment challenges, understand their unique objectives, and identify the investment strategies, portfolios, and solutions best suited to their needs. The platform includes professionals across business development, relationship management, and product management who support a diverse range of institutional investors, including public pension funds, central banks, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, retirement plan sponsors, and mutual fund sponsors. Responsibilities may include analyzing new business opportunities by region or channel, supporting business analytics, conducting competitive analysis and due diligence, engaging with Wellington’s evolving technologies and client-related applications, and helping evaluate investment opportunities.
Finance – The Finance team provides financial stewardship and strategic support across Wellington's global business. Through financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, expense management, tax, and corporate finance activities, the team helps guide business decisions, allocate resources, and support the firm's long-term growth. Interns may contribute to financial analysis and modeling, budgeting processes, management reporting, tax research, and other projects that provide insight into how a global investment management firm operates.
Global Operations – This function drives the firm's operational edge to exceed the investment and service expectations of our clients worldwide. Working across investment, client, and infrastructure teams, the group designs and executes the processes, controls, and infrastructure that support Wellington's world-class investment strategies and client relationships. The team plays a critical role in supporting client onboarding and servicing, investment activities, operational reporting, and responding to the evolving needs of our global client base. Interns will gain a practical understanding of how operational processes are built to deliver scalability, risk mitigation, service excellence, and a high-quality client experience.
Legal, Compliance & Risk – Help the firm operate effectively in a complex regulatory environment with evolving compliance programs, you will contribute to the completion of risk-mitigating projects, and conduct analysis and reporting. Responsibilities may include tagging and analyzing key risk management metrics, gaining proficiencies in regulatory requirements of regimes applicable to a US investment adviser, assisting with due diligence process for new and critical vendors, and assisting with the testing of control design and effectiveness.
Investment Implementation & Trading – Opportunity to gain practical experience in the dynamic world of markets and trading. Responsibilities may include supporting the firm’s domestic and international post-execution trade activities, interacting with traders and brokers, and conducting trading data analysis. You will gain a solid foundation in trading and trade confirmation practices associated with today’s global financial markets. You will learn about a variety of markets, the role of trading at Wellington, the trade lifecycle, and how we work with portfolio managers who invest on behalf of our clients. Additionally, you will gain experience in industry applications such as Bloomberg, and CTM.
What You’ll Gain
Throughout the program, interns will:
Gain exposure to the investment management industry
Work on real projects with business impact and gain in-depth understanding of their function
Build skills in analysis, communication, and problem solving
Mentorship and feedback opportunities that focus on learning and growth
Participate in professional development workshops
Network with professionals and fellow interns
Who Should Apply
We welcome students from a broad range of majors, backgrounds and experiences who are interested in learning about business and investment management.
We look for:
Current sophomore and junior undergraduate students from all academic majors working toward a bachelors degree
Strong communication, attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills
Curious and adaptable, with an interest in leveraging emerging technologies and AI tools to improve efficiency, enhance decision-making and discover smarter ways of working
Interest in business, finance, or operations
Participation in on-campus activities, leadership roles, volunteer opportunities and work experiences
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
No prior finance experience is required.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
Application Deadline: October 2, 2026
Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

About the Role
Our Placement Internship is a year-long programme offering an exceptional introduction to the Investment Management industry. Starting in June 2027, the internship spans twelve months and provides opportunities across a variety of departments. You will play an integral role within your team, taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to delivering excellence for our clients and positively impacting millions of beneficiaries worldwide. Successful candidates will be based at our London Victoria office.
WHO CAN APPLY
This programme is designed for penultimate-year undergraduate students who are eager to explore a career in investment management. We welcome applications from all degree disciplines.
At Wellington Management, you’ll find opportunities across our three core platforms:
Client Platform – focused on delivering exceptional client experiences
Investment Platform – driving investment excellence and innovation
Infrastructure – enabling the firm through technology and operational expertise
There are three job advertisements, one for each platform. This advertisement relates specifically to the Client Platform.
CLIENT PLATFORM
Client Group
Includes business development, relationship management, client service, and marketing functions across all geographies and channels, including institutions, consultants, intermediaries, and wealth managers.
Product Management
Management of investment products across their lifecycle, ensuring they align with client needs and market trends. It acts as a strategic link between investment teams, distribution, and clients to deliver innovative, scalable, and commercially effective solutions.

Responsible for the firm's editorial, communications, design, client programs, and external web efforts. The team is collectively charged with creating and implementing marketing and communication strategies that promote the firm's investment capabilities and thought leadership, foster its global brand, and drive client engagement.
The successful candidates will:
Be an undergraduate student who is eligible for a year-long industrial placement in your penultimate year of study – beginning June 2027
Have skills or experiences which demonstrate an interest in a career within investment management.
Be a highly motivated self-starter with a high intellectual curiosity.
Be proactive and have the humility and willingness to learn from and collaborate with their colleagues.
Possess outstanding interpersonal and organisational skills, be resourceful, detail-oriented, and have a strong work ethic.
Able to work independently, in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment, where priorities change frequently.
Have strong systems skills, in particular familiarity and versatility in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
